rows.note: This is the all-purpose word for the tobacco plant and tobacco as a smoking or chewing product.

example.english: The tobacco flavour of this brand is very strong.
example.traditional: 呢個牌子嘅煙草味好濃。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 paai4 zi2 ge3 jin1 cou2 mei6 hou2 nung4

rows.note: Use this specifically for tobacco leaves as a raw material, rather than tobacco products generally.

example.english: These tobacco leaves have to be dried first before they can be sent for processing.
example.traditional: 呢批煙葉要先曬乾，之後先可以送去加工。
example.jyutping: ni1 pai1 jin1 jip6 jiu3 sin1 saai3 gon1 zi1 hau6 sin1 ho2 ji5 sung3 heoi3 gaa1 gung1
